component.name: Machine Lab
component.summary: Run other Linux and Windows machines on this Mac

description.p: Machine Lab creates and runs ARM64 virtual machines with QEMU and KVM, with the look and feel of an elementary OS app.

See each machine's desktop in a built-in Display tab with full screen, mouse and keyboard, pause and resume, a live console, and readiness and disk-space checks. Import guests already managed with mseries-vm, or create new ones from elementary OS, Omarchy, Ubuntu, Debian, Fedora or any ARM64 installer image.
Disk snapshots: save and restore a machine before risky changes.
Incus containers and virtual machines managed from the sidebar.
x86-64 machines under software emulation, clearly labelled as slower.
Clipboard sharing with guests over the QEMU D-Bus display (text, guest to host verified).
Display tab with full screen, in-app mouse and keyboard, a macOS experiment page, masked credentials, a non-blocking status poll and a test suite.
